pages.title: Dawn
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords, Axes, Tridents$(br2)§lEffect: §r Killing mobs permanently grows your damage and crit stats. Low-health targets always take a critical hit; kills grant lifesteal and splash damage.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with other melee damage/growth enchantments.
